notes.title: 《LUNA》 is now officially on Steam! Add it to your wishlist now!
notes.content:
Dear players, thank you for your patience!

Developed by Hypnosis Lab and published by WorkNite, the brand-new immersive Yuri Roguelite deck-building game — 《LUNA》 has officially launched its Steam page!
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/dfad2cb190d56a18ad3acc2c67cf695e918b7427.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/ac52068d009df2428df1a8043aa7aca6c0578fcc.png[/img]


In West City, 2135, half a century after mysterious superpowers emerged, society has undergone dramatic changes. "Superpowered criminals" - undetectable, unpredictable, and untraceable - have become a massive threat to social stability and prosperity.
In this chaotic era, the peace-loving superpowered girl "Luna" decides to follow her sister's path and join the government as a security officer to protect people.
At this critical moment, the terrorist organization "Liberators" hidden in a corner of the city begins large-scale operations— The rookie female officer Luna will soon understand that the "Liberators" are far more than just heinous superpowered criminals. Facing conflicting beliefs, people's lamentations, and historical truths... how will this society of superpowers navigate such despair?

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/18a3b2d02fb4855bfdb091327b52184dbfb471a3.png[/img]

[h3][b] ◤ Terrorist Organization — Liberators ◢ [/b][/h3]
Challenge unique female bosses with mysterious superpowers, where every decision will change the battle's direction.

[h3][b] ◤ Roguelite Card Building ◢ [/b][/h3]
Craft your exclusive skill card deck at the base, upgrade and combine for powerful chain effects, and break through randomly generated challenges with imagination!

[h3][b] ◤ Unveil the Superpower World ◢ [/b][/h3]
Using the "Replication" superpower, gradually uncover the truth of the superpowered society and embark on a path filled with mysteries and choices.

[h3][b] ◤ Yuri Supreme ◢ [/b][/h3]
Experience deep and delicate bonds between female characters while exploring the truth!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/c19bd8e11538bb418c61f474edce6ad1c603cde6.jpg[/img]

Add to your Wishlist now and be the first to receive launch notifications!

Published by Eternal Alice Studio and developed by F Project, the vertical scrolling action game "Falling with Ice Phoenix!" now has a store page on Steam. Scheduled for release in November 2024, interested players can add it to their wishlist to stay updated!

[h2][b]"Retrieve the Lost Orb: A Stairway Adventure for Adults"[/b][/h2]

In a distant, otherworldly land, the protagonist Tavaro, piloting his aircraft, suddenly encounters a storm and crashes. The falling aircraft collides with the Crystal Palace at the top of the Sky Tower.

The Sky Tower, located at the center of the continent, is filled with monsters and traps, and the Crystal Palace is the central hub of the Sky Tower. Flovia, the lord of the Crystal Palace, is playing with the frost orb that controls the entire palace when the crash occurs. Due to the collision caused by Tavaro, Flovia accidentally drops the orb to the bottom of the tower, causing the monsters to lose control and rampage.

To help Flovia retrieve the lost orb, Tavaro uses his expertise to guide her in descending techniques, and the two set off together towards the lower levels. Facing trap-filled floors and malevolent monster lords, an adventure full of unknowns and challenges begins...

[h2][b]"Classic Gameplay with New Twists"[/b][/h2]

Inspired by the famous Japanese mini-game "NS-SHAFT", this vertical scrolling action game incorporates many new elements, including special mechanism floors, hovering techniques, boss attacks, and of course, the "action" elements beloved by old gentlemen!

CreSpirit has announced that their 2D platform action-adventure game, "TEVI," is set to be officially released on November 30th for Nintendo Switch and Steam. The PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One versions are scheduled for release in the first half of next year. 
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/9b5862973cb80136115f37132671379bf1101805.jpg[/img]

[h3]《TEVI》Steam Link[/h3]

[h3]《TEVI》Trailer[/h3]
https://youtu.be/W8nZ-bgrC6k

[h2]Game Play[/h2]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/35f808cad181100fb308336fab47b4bcaf29802d.jpg[/img]
TEVI is a 2D side-scrolling Metroidvania. Focusing on fast-paced bullet hell gameplay and a flashy combo system, the game also features intricate melee and ranged combat, dodge systems, a boss-staggering BREAK mechanic and more. Customize your playstyle with a vast array of equippables that can be crafted or discovered through exploration! 


[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/51b94fe93002d9923d261731b0fb12c696d2ea1d.jpg[/img]
● This game features:
-A vast and vibrant interconnected world with 40+ areas
-A sweeping OST featuring 70+ original track
-A colorful cast of 50+ characters with voice acting
-Over 300 pieces of equipment and abilities to collect
-More than 20 unique boss battles

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/490bda5bf37f7e53980031932190c332225e039a.jpg[/img]

In addition to its rich exploration elements and combat system, "TEVI" has invited several beloved composers such as Triodust, Oli Jan, and 3R2 to craft over 70 original tracks for the game. Furthermore, the game features full Japanese voice acting for the entire storyline, with the participation of numerous professional voice actors including Lynn, Yōko Hikasa, Natsumi Fujiwara, Tomokazu Sugita, Rie Kugimiya, Rie Tanaka, Takehito Koyasu, and more, totaling over 50 voice roles. The aim is to enhance the auditory experience and provide players with a more immersive gaming journey.

[h2]Story[/h2]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/911bb78dc04e2371a6a43b915aee95b8c54e4f52.jpg[/img]
Join Tevi and her companions Sable and Celia on an epic journey across a sprawling fantasy world full of mystery - the continent of Az.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36388466/7b6aa24c7a332086bff460bb00f4b4462c3289c6.jpg[/img]
From the fallen imperial capital city to the demonic underworld deep beneath, or the oceanic depths to the luminous floating realms of the angels, wonder and danger lurk around every corner. Discover histories, civilizations, and the people that shape them. Meet a large cast of friends, foes, and everything in between, and unravel the mysteries behind a darkness that looms over the land...

notes.title: Eternal Alice Studio- Official Dissolution Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/d90ccb73fabdf15cc1054f7895b4f349ff6c797a.jpg[/img]
Hi everyone, I am Aolun, the person in charge of Eternal Alice Studio. I believe many of you have seen the news on our official Facebook page already. Actually, I originally wanted to discuss this with everyone in the "Alice Mansion" section of our last work, "Blades of Jianghu: Ballad of Wind and Dust" However, after the project was launched, there were only me and another technical partner left in the company.

[i]The figure of us working hard to fix bugs.[/i]
[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/61fbad0b0f58f39c6b617468a61214f52b2c7341.jpg][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/eba05be99736481b7cc0cd20ad4e4fe66ac34552.jpg[/img][/url]

In fact, I am a very nostalgic person who loves classic RPGs from 15-20 years ago. In Taiwan, examples include Daewoo's Twin Swords, Yujun's "Peerless Shuangjiao," Yuquan's "Meteor Butterfly Sword," Hantang's "Heaven and Earth Catastrophe," etc. In Japan, there are Xuze's Eternal Sword series, Eushully's Valkyrie series, AliceSoft's Rance, and the large OO series, among others.

Now that I have the ability to start my own company and make games, it is only natural that I aim to emulate these companies that have produced countless classic masterpieces. However, as the company grows, I have less and less time to consider what I should consider as a "game producer" before being a boss (such as how to make the game more fun and practical). The financial pressure I face is also growing, gradually crushing my passion for making games. I have become increasingly dissatisfied with each new work we release, which is gradually becoming mediocre and commercialized, yet always smuggling some of my immature ideals, resulting in a more and more "neither fish nor fowl" product.It also indirectly resulted in declining sales.

I am getting more and more tired and powerless about these situations, sighing every day about my own lack of ability, unable to bring better experiences to players and better results to my company partners.

So, in January this year, I quickly reached a consensus with several core partners in the company - to dissolve the "Eternal Alice Workshop," which has carried so many memories over the past five years.
- - -
Although as the person in charge of the company, I may have ended things here,but as a game producer, have not given up on my dream of continuing to create ero and fun games. I will keep on creating in the future, hoping that one day I can return to everyone with better works. Thank you all.

Lastly, I'd like to share a family portrait of the characters from our works so far. This also symbolizes my expectation and vision for the spirit of Eternal Alice. I hope to see you all again someday.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/d17bf04a5bfdaa2f924763eacea689ca775fd4f2.jpg[/img]

[h1]【Story Theme】[/h1]
Distinct from previous works, this game features a love adventure story with a wuxia theme and rich content.

The story depicts Gong Zhen, a young martial arts novice who has just entered the ambiguous world of Jianghu. He accidentally gets involved in a series of shocking cases and encounters two powerful female figures in the realm.

"Singing in the dead of night, accompanied by a beautiful lady."
"The young man travels the Jianghu with his sword, where does his journey end?"
"The long road ahead, dust-stained and weary."
"I raise a toast to you and we compose the dreams of chivalry."

Will Gong Zhen be able to embrace the beauties and become a lucky guy who enjoys all the blessings? It all depends on the skills of you, the experienced players!

[h1]【Gameplay】[/h1]
The gameplay features turn-based combat with different skill combinations by switching team formations. Players must carefully consider skill combinations and positioning when facing powerful enemies to achieve victory.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/b2de0a0a5bec9edf15dfff8c7843af94fddecd38.png[/img]

notes.title: 【Alice Publication】New HGame《Happiness Double Room》Introduction
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/aef20649d89b6906770573ea375a0dce2bc134c9.png[/img]

Developed by ConnectionGame, the developer of the heart-warming romance game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203970]"The Warmth Between Us"[/url], and published in cooperation with Alice Publication, the practical love-raising interactive game "Happiness Double Room" is scheduled for release in the second half of 2022!

[url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1897120/[/url]


[url=https://youtu.be/RRt-Rb0Rcew]Game PV[/url] https://youtu.be/RRt-Rb0Rcew
[h1]Story[/h1]

When you are at a low point in your life, that person, the big sister you have never met, appears in front of you.
This time, she will take you, together through the end of the happy summer.


[h1]Game Features[/h1]

[b]◆Easy Interactive System[/b]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/c13b5b9b9d113cab83ed78fb6e68dce3bf815df2.jpg[/img]
No burdens, no worries, enjoy it all is what your sister asks of you!
At the same time, each interaction will have a special contextual atmosphere, and the colorful sister will be visible in your eyes.

In addition, this game supports one-handed operation!

[b]◆Gorgeous and rich lewd animation scene[/b]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/ba9a086473f9874185444eed3440854e34335f36.gif[/img]
12 animated CGs, up to 27 CGs and over 400 CGs including differential changes!

In the sweet little room, various erotic events with your sister will be performed in Live2D, and Minami's voice will be dubbed in Japanese throughout, so there will be no cold scenes!

Each event will have about 10 variations with interactive commands, from "-beep-" to "-beep-", so you can experience it freely!


[b]◆Multiple endings and different choices[/b]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36388466/79255dab6fa61111c3f77815d82981dabf270f31.jpg[/img]

In the end, it's up to you to decide how this period will end. ......
It will be towards a happy future, or as fleeting as a firework?
